iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

TCP::proxybufferlow
       Gets proxy buffer low threshold.

SYNOPSIS
       TCP::proxybufferlow

DESCRIPTION
       Gets the threshold at which the proxy buffer starts sending new data, in bytes.

       Syntax

       TCP::proxybufferlow

RETURN VALUE
       The proxy buffer low threshold.

VALID DURING
       SERVER_INIT, SERVER_CONNECTED, SERVER_DATA

EXAMPLES
	when SERVER_CONNECTED {
	    log local0.debug "[TCP::proxybufferlow]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
       TCP::proxybuffer TCP::proxybufferhigh

CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-13.0.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
